prefix: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production four-pose sprite atlas for Torii & Hutukara musical action RPG. Reference images are style/canonical appearance references only; do NOT copy their background, layout, other characters or titles. Detailed chibi pixel-art contours with dark outlines, controlled colored shading, 16-bit-inspired art readable at 58 to 160 screen pixels high.
suffix: Produce ONLY this single enemy identity in FOUR consistent full-body poses within a STRICT equal-cell 2x2 grid: top left idle, top right anticipation, bottom left strike/execution, bottom right hurt/recoil. All are front or front-three-quarter facing the camera, same design, same apparent scale and baseline/ground-projection point. Generous transparent margins around EACH sprite, no crossing cell borders. True transparent background and negative spaces. No text, labels, grid lines, floor, cast shadows, scenery, health bars, auras, explosions, projectile effects or human protagonists. These are discrete pose drawings, not frames with motion blur. Preserve all identifying props consistently across poses.
enemies: Compact round tightly knotted bundle of violet shadow and torn fabric, small ivory face with vertical microphone grille, two short projecting shadow tips. Idle tightly curled, anticipation compresses its core, strike opens the two short tips, hurt twists the knot. Strong round silhouette, NOT the tall hooded ghost.

Preserve the ghost at bottom row third column of reference: narrow elongated tattered violet hood, ivory vertical microphone-grille face, long pale spectral hands, floating tapering ragged tail. Idle hovering, anticipation pulls hands inward, strike extends spectral hands, hurt arches its body. No human skin: its hands are spectral ivory.

Small animated mechanical musical metronome, trapezoid ivory and aged amber/brass body, one large exposed pendulum clearly visible, dark purple base, no human face. Idle pendulum slightly offset, anticipation pendulum leans far to side, strike pendulum snaps centrally with body open, hurt pendulum tilted askew. NO embedded motion streaks or aura.

Narrow supernatural ghost made of large cyan reflective mirror plates, cracked oval mirror as face, two large side shards, hollow dark center, purple small joins. Idle symmetrical, anticipation draws shards inward, strike opens both shards in front, hurt breaks symmetry. No protagonist reflection and no human face.

Low wide heavy inhuman purple sound-dampening creature, armored graphite-violet shell, two huge padded circular earmuff discs at its sides, sealed small core, squat base, NO human face. Idle wide and closed, anticipation folds side discs shut around core, strike thrusts discs forward, hurt exposes narrow glowing crack. Clearly wide silhouette not a round fabric knot.

Small spectral creature of magenta/cyan twisted cassette ribbons, one cracked ivory face plate (NOT radial Torii mask), few large floating fragments, compact floating tail. Idle loosely curled, anticipation coils ribbons tightly, strike opens ribbon limbs, hurt displaces mask and ribbons. Smaller simpler relative of final Silence boss.

Preserve rounded floating robot lower-left of reference enemy roster: weathered graphite and brass shell, one big circular cyan lens, magenta side panel, two antennae, small dangling mechanical tabs. Idle hovering, anticipation closes side flaps, strike opens side emitters WITHOUT projectiles, hurt tilts shell and lens. No legs, no guns, no new weapon.

Preserve spectral radio priest at bottom-right of reference 2: burgundy and aged gold vestments, cracked ivory central mask with dark eye sockets, two old radios around shoulders/head, orbital antenna crown, glowing radio emitter chest, trailing cassette ribbons, floating ragged hem. Idle majestic, anticipation lights radio emitters and gathers sleeves, strike spreads sleeves/antennae, hurt contracts entire silhouette. Not a human giant.

Preserve heavy robot bottom center of reference1: bulky weathered graphite/violet armor, narrow horizontal magenta visor, huge rectangular shield bearing two round magenta loudspeakers on one arm, long other mechanical arm, large wide feet. Same shield arm in every pose. Idle braced, anticipation locks shield forward, strike opens arm and speaker emitters, hurt leans torso retaining shield. No new weapons.

Preserve final spectral monster bottom-right of reference1: tall open asymmetric body of shadow ribbons violet/magenta, split ivory broken face-mask with deep black voids, floating fragmented cyan signal panels. NOT the radial Torii mask, no human skin/hair/boots/clothing. Idle floating, anticipation contracts ribbons inward, strike opens hollow center and ribbons wide, hurt loses cohesion. Majestic and wider/more complex than masked traveler.
